FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A85
The Washington rule bans holding any electronic device while driving for every driver, while hands-free use stays permitted, so the test line is holding, not talking. [A85]
Why it matters: group_hint distracted-driving-law; prereq_hint sec06-F16; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F17.
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A86
Doubling applies to distracted driving fines after your first violation, not to the first ticket itself. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint distracted-driving-law; prereq_hint sec06-R01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec06-F18.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A83
Observe is noticing that something changed, whereas Orient is working out what that change means for your safety and others before you Decide. [A83]
Why it matters: group_hint ooda-loop; prereq_hint sec06-F11; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec06-F12.
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A87
Searching uses your eyes alone to check around you, while scanning also moves your head, neck and body to widen what you can see. [A87]
Why it matters: group_hint visual-search; prereq_hint sec06-F21; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F22.
Source: [A87 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A86
Switching attention jumps quickly from one thing to another, divided attention handles several things at once, focused attention puts the whole mind on one task, and sustained attention holds it over a long time. [A86]
Why it matters: group_hint attention-types; prereq_hint sec06-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec06-F20.
Source: [A86 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A84
Fatigue and discomfort count as physical distractions, while daydreaming, worry and strong emotions are mental distractions, so a distraction need not involve a phone. [A84]
Why it matters: group_hint distraction-types; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F13.
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A82
In the guide's decision approach the final check comes last, after informing yourself and others and after preparing your position and speed, right before the maneuver. [A82]
Why it matters: group_hint decision-steps; prereq_hint sec06-F04; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F08.
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A80
Road rage in progress goes straight to 911, and the same number is used to report a witnessed aggressive driving act. [A80]
Why it matters: group_hint reporting; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec06-F01, sec06-F02.
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A81
Teens face a still-developing judgment center in the brain, while older drivers face physical and mental changes with age, two different reasons the guide gives for extra care. [A81]
Why it matters: group_hint age-and-decisions; prereq_hint sec06-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F06, sec06-F07.
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A90
State law fixes only the minimum littering fines, and cities and counties may set their own different rules on top of it. [A90]
Why it matters: group_hint litter; prereq_hint sec06-F30; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F31.
Source: [A90 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A91
The Clean Car Law covers vehicles built in 2009 and later and blocks registering, licensing or selling one that fails the clean air standards. [A91]
Why it matters: group_hint environment; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F33.
Source: [A91 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0091]
